summary: The kernel computes a synchronous add-only fixed point over opaque generic facts. Caller identify is authoritative for IDs; supplied duplicates keep the first occurrence, each round reads the same canonical snapshot, and derivation ties use FactId/RuleId ordering. Monotone rules over a bounded fact space are a documented precondition, not runtime validation or a universal termination guarantee for arbitrary plugins. Host loops represent read/review/persist/output as effect data, while CLI/interpreters perform filesystem, process and rendering effects. Route/gate/verify commands have separate pure cores and interpreter layers. Preserve this distinction when claiming deterministic policy, source-qualified routing or native enforcement; the kernel alone grants no effect authority.
title: Governance kernel is pure reasoning; hosts interpret effect data
